references.name: reference/view1-from-the-sea
references.shows: The whole town from the sea south of the quay: the harbour and quay, the main street climbing to the square, the cathedral and the inn, the castle on its mountain above, the headland and lighthouse to the right. The style anchor for the series.

references.name: reference/view2-from-the-castle
references.shows: The town from the castle gate on the summit, looking down the zig-zag road to the square, the main street and the harbour, the headland and lighthouse beyond.

references.name: reference/view3-plan
references.shows: The town as a straight-down plan: the castle on the mountain at the top, the road down to the square, the cathedral and inn either side of it, the main street to the quay, the cliff path along the headland to the lighthouse.

references.name: concept/square-near
references.shows: Scene 1, near: Hedda at the inn door with her clipboard, the cathedral front and a half-built stage across the square.

references.name: concept/square-far
references.shows: Scene 1, far: the square from the top of the main street, the inn and the cathedral on either side, the castle on its mountain above.

references.name: concept/castle-near
references.shows: Scene 2, near: the castle's great hall, Lady Agathe beside the stitched dragon costume, a jackdaw on its nest in the tail, Bernt at the door and Dumpling the happy ghast overhead.

references.name: concept/castle-far
references.shows: Scene 2, far: the castle gate from the last stretch of its road, the town falling away below to the harbour.

references.name: concept/lighthouse-near
references.shows: Scene 3, near: inside the lighthouse, Sanna rehearsing to six painted buoys, Inga watching from the door.

references.name: concept/lighthouse-far
references.shows: Scene 3, far: the cliff path along the headland to the lighthouse, the harbour and the town on the slope beside it.

references.name: concept/forge-near
references.shows: Scene 4, near: Runa's open forge with the oven door hung over it, Runa and Oskar arguing beneath it.

references.name: concept/street-far
references.shows: Scene 4, far: the main street stepping down to the harbour, the bakery's loaf sign on one side and the smithy's anvil sign lower on the other.

references.name: concept/tavern-near
references.shows: Scene 5, near: the sailors' tavern garden under its vine pergola, Fenna on a barrel with her music and three empty chairs.

references.name: concept/lane-far
references.shows: Scene 5, far: the lower street with the boatwright's shed, the cooperage and the net loft, the harbour beyond.

references.name: concept/weaver-near
references.shows: Scene 6, near: Elin in her loom room holding up the new red-and-gold curtain.

references.name: concept/guildhall-far
references.shows: Scene 6, far: the guildhall on its arcade with the clock over the door, Vidar Foss on the steps, the tavern across the street.

references.name: concept/stage-near
references.shows: Scene 7, near: the play on the stage on the square at sunset, the Dragon and the Founder with her loaf, the town on the benches.

references.name: concept/square-far-sunset
references.shows: Scene 7, far: the square from the cathedral steps at sunset, the stage and the full benches, the town and the sea beyond.
